text: Both Bitcoin and Ethereum are rallying in sync at +4.2% over 24 hours, with Bitcoin holding 59.3% dominance and the Fear & Greed index climbing into greed territory at 74, signaling confident risk appetite across the market. The $107B in 24-hour volume reflects sustained participation rather than panic-driven moves, and the uniform gains across altcoins like BNB and SOL suggest broad-based strength rather than Bitcoin-only momentum. The +1 point rise in sentiment over the past week indicates this greed phase is building gradually, typical of accumulation-phase markets rather than euphoric tops.
